messages:
Maria Castro: Canary rollout for rls-2024-09 (kernel selector refactor + batching tweak) looks noisy on canary-1, getting p95 spikes.

Thomas Li: saw the alert. p95 token-latency ~+38% vs baseline for 8k context traces, p50 ~+12%.

deploy-bot: [deploy] Started rollout rls-2024-09 -> canary-1 (10% traffic) by Maria Castro at 2024-08-29T14:13:01Z

Eli Rao: Any CI perf failures before merge? I recall one microbench with +8% noise but CI was green overall.

Maria Castro: CI was green on main, but I flagged that flaky infra perf test. It still got merged after approvals.

Thomas Li: Quick profiler notes: kernel launch count up, effective batch_fill lower on canary. KV cache hit-rate dropped ~6% for long-tail convos.

SRE Oncall: SLO guard triggered: canary p95 > 20% of baseline threshold. Auto-pause threshold is 15%; it paused around 14:58 UTC then was manually resumed.

Maria Castro: Who resumed? If the regression is reproducible we should rollback.

Eli Rao: That was me. Thought it was a noisy spike and wanted more samples. I can revert if we confirm root cause.

QA Bot: Repro steps: replay prod trace -> compare canary vs baseline images with same model and seed. Reproduced latency increase locally for small batch sizes (1-4) and long contexts (~6k tokens).

Thomas Li: Hypothesis: batcher change reduces cross-request packing (smaller pack window) so more small batches, and kernel selector change causes more kernel-switch overhead for long sequences. Combined effect spikes p95.

Maria Castro: Suspect PRs: PR#4928 kernel selector favors grouped GEMM <=1024, PR#4932 batcher: limit pack window to 50ms, PR#4941 kv-cache lazy eviction timing.

Eli Rao: 4932 seems likely 11 shrinking pack window increases small batches -> poor GPU util for long seqs.

Thomas Li: Kernel selector could also be creating extra small kernel launches. Need quick bisect. Can we rollback 4932 on canary only?

Maria Castro: Plan: instant rollback to baseline image on canary, re-run traffic replay. If perf restores, revert 4932 until we fix heuristics.

deploy-bot: [action] Rolling canary-1 -> baseline-image (rls-2024-08) requested by Maria Castro at 2024-08-29T15:02:18Z

SRE Oncall: Recommend tightening rollout gate: require p95_sample_count >= 200 and p95_delta < 12% over 15m before auto-advance. Current gate: 50 samples and 10m.

Eli Rao: Agree. Also hook kv_hit_rate into gate: fail if kv_hit_rate drops >3% vs baseline for any long-context route.

Thomas Li: Long-term: add CI micro-replay with mixed batch sizes and long contexts; fail if kernel-launches increase >10% or batch_fill drops >8%.

Maria Castro: Can we automate bisect to toggle PR flags? We have a canary-bisect job but it only toggles service flags today. Need per-PR diffs.

deploy-bot: [note] Canary-bisect job exists but limited. Extendable with a prioritized request.

Eli Rao: Fast mitigation: revert PR#4932 in canary and re-evaluate. If that fixes it, open a follow-up to make pack window adaptive to batch_fill/latency.

QA Bot: Queued traffic replay for rolled-back canary, will post numbers in ~10m.

Thomas Li: Also asking infra to check GPU/kernel driver logs for fallback kernels or path changes; could explain sudden launch-count spike.

Maria Castro: Action items: Eli revert 4932 in canary, QA run replay and post results, Thomas check kernel logs and add CI perf scenario, SRE Oncall tighten rollout gate temporarily. Reconvene in 20m.

Eli Rao: Reverting 4932 in canary now.

deploy-bot: [deploy] Rollback complete: canary-1 image -> rls-2024-08 (rollback by Eli Rao) at 2024-08-29T15:18:42Z

QA Bot: Preliminary results: p95 back within +6% of baseline, p50 unchanged. kv_hit_rate restored. batch_fill improved ~11% in replay.

Thomas Li: Looks like the batching window was main culprit. Kernel-selector investigation lower priority now but still on the list.

Maria Castro: Next steps: open rollback PR for 4932, update rollout gates as proposed, add CI perf test. Also creating an automatic rollback rule: if canary p95 >15% for 10m with >=200 samples, auto-rollback (no manual override until investigation tag).

SRE Oncall: Acknowledged 11 pushing gate change and auto-rollback rule to infra config.

Eli Rao: I'll draft an adaptive pack-window follow-up: adjust window by observed batch_fill and token throughput.

Maria Castro: Great. Closing thread once infra confirms gate changes and PRs are open.
